annotations.title: List company-owned cases or conversations with emotion filters (sentiment: happy, neutral, upset, angry, sad, mixed or unknown), a customer filter (customer: paid for a captured or authorized live payment, no_purchase for a matched contact who has not paid, unmatched for an unknown sender), ordering (sort, including customer_message for the latest customer message first), page size, coverage and a cursor

description: List company-owned cases or conversations with emotion filters (sentiment: happy, neutral, upset, angry, sad, mixed or unknown), a customer filter (customer: paid for a captured or authorized live payment, no_purchase for a matched contact who has not paid, unmatched for an unknown sender), ordering (sort, including customer_message for the latest customer message first), page size, coverage and a cursor. Operational rows include conversationSentiment (label, confidence, evidence references, source, assessed_at and pending freshness). Operational filters require the company's operational connection; Messenger-only results include coverage limits.

snoozed.description: Active cases leave out snoozed cases: not waiting on the team, with a follow-up still in the future. true lists only snoozed cases.
